name: hubbard_sqd
title: Ground state of an 8-site Fermi-Hubbard chain (16 qubits)
description: Open 1D Hubbard chain, t = 1, U = 4 (particle-hole symmetric form), half filling, Sz = 0. Find the ground-state energy.
goal: Ground-state energy within a few percent while diagonalising less than the full symmetry sector.
